context: A civics lecture on political parties
purpose: Explain parties; teach 自民党/見解/公務員/把握/連合/趣旨/児童/又は

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 今日は政党の役割を学びます。
lines.en: Today we learn the role of political parties.
lines.style: organized teacher opening the unit, each word carrying genuine natural feeling

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 自民党は、長く与党を務めてきましたね。
lines.en: The LDP has long been the ruling party.
lines.style: informed student stating a fact, voice clear and distinctly their own

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: ええ、政府の見解は政策に反映されます。
lines.en: Yes, the government’s views shape policy.
lines.style: teacher explaining the linkage, tone holding steady through the whole line

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 公務員は、その政策を実行するんですね。
lines.en: Civil servants carry out that policy.
lines.style: teen connecting the roles, delivery emotionally grounded and unforced

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: そうです。現場の状況を把握する力が要ります。
lines.en: Right. Grasping the field situation is essential.
lines.style: teacher stressing a key skill, spoken with a recognizable personal cadence

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 労働組合の連合も、政治に影響しますか？
lines.en: Do labor-union federations affect politics too?
lines.style: student probing another actor, each word carrying genuine natural feeling

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: ええ。法案の趣旨を理解することが大切です。
lines.en: Yes. Understanding a bill’s intent matters.
lines.style: teacher emphasizing comprehension, voice clear and distinctly their own

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 児童福祉のような分野も、議論されますよね。
lines.en: Fields like child welfare are debated too, right?
lines.style: teen widening the scope, tone holding steady through the whole line

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 支援の対象は、低所得世帯又は単身家庭などです。
lines.en: Recipients are low-income or single-person households, etc.
lines.style: teacher giving a precise example, delivery emotionally grounded and unforced
